copy.headline: Annual Dallas Cowboys Thanksgiving Day game menu revealed
copy.caption: Fans will once again be able to enjoy all their favorite Thanksgiving holiday menu classics on Thursday, Nov. 26, when the Dallas Cowboys face off against the Philadelphia Eagles at AT&T Stadium in Arlington. The Legends Global team previewed the menu Tuesday, which includes the Thanksgiving Roll, Thanksgiving Bowl and Thanksgiving Hand Pie, all dishes that have the traditional flavors of a Thanksgiving meal.

story.title: Annual Dallas Cowboys Thanksgiving Day game menu revealed
story.summary: Thanksgiving Roll, Bowl or Hand Pie? See what’s on the Dallas Cowboys Thanksgiving Day menu and where to find it inside AT&T Stadium. Fans will once again be able to enjoy all their favorite Thanksgiving holiday menu classics on Thursday, Nov. 26, when the Dallas Cowboys face off against the Philadelphia Eagles at AT&T Stadium in Arlington. The Legends Global team previewed the menu Tuesday, which includes the Thanksgiving Roll, Thanksgiving Bowl and Thanksgiving Hand Pie, all dishes that have the traditional flavors of a Thanksgiving meal. The Thanksgiving Roll includes savory herb dressing, green beans, sweet potatoes, cranberry sauce and house pecan-and-hickory smoked turkey bundled and fried in a crispy egg roll wrap.
